# Noisy Terminal Output Sample
This simulates poor OCR quality with common recognition errors.

> cargo new my_project
> cd my_project  
> cargo add serde --features ["derive"]
> cargo add tokio --features ["full"]

✅ New proj ect created successfully!

$ git init  
$ git add .
$ git commit -m "Initial commit"

Error: You need to sign your commits. Use:
$ git config --global user.signingkey <your_key>
$ git config --global commit.gpgsign true

$ cargo run
   Compiling my_project v0.1.0 (...)
    Finished dev [unoptimized + debuginfo] target(s) in 2.45s  
     Running `target/debug/my_project`
Hello, word!

WARNING: This text simulates common OCR errors including:
- Character substitution (e.g., "world" -> "word")  
- Spurious spaces
- Line breaks in wrong places
- Missing punctuation
